name: Payments Council of India
role: Apex payments-industry council formed in 2013 under the aegis of IAMAI; self-describes as representing 90%+ of the payments industry; runs committees (merchant aggregators & acquirers, payment processors, networks) and publishes policy-position pages on regulation.

name: Internet and Mobile Association of India
role: Industry body for internet and mobile businesses; parent under whose aegis PCI was formed; files consultation responses and policy positions across digital payments and platform regulation.

name: NASSCOM
role: IT-industry body; self-published its feedback on RBI's Charges-in-Payment-Systems discussion paper (Oct 2022), arguing that zero or low fees can deter innovation and competition — a documented position on the UPI pricing question.

name: Indian Banks' Association
role: Association of banks and the banking interest; engages regulators on banking rules; standard commenter on RBI consultation papers.

name: FICCI
role: Industry chamber; files consultation responses across financial-sector regulation through committees and task forces.

name: Confederation of Indian Industry
role: Industry chamber; files consultation responses across financial-sector regulation through committees and task forces.

name: ASSOCHAM
role: Industry chamber; files consultation responses across financial-sector regulation through committees and task forces.

name: US-India Strategic Partnership Forum
role: US business forum advocating for member companies in India including financial services; engages on fintech and digital-economy policy with Indian regulators and government.

name: iSPIRT Foundation
role: Non-profit software think tank behind India Stack advocacy; registered in UFF's member roster (SROTrac). A policy NGO with an unusual seat at the table: builds and pitches the infrastructure the state then regulates.

name: Digital India Foundation
role: Policy foundation working on digital-economy issues incl. payments and platform regulation; files submissions and op-eds in regulatory debates.

name: Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy
role: Independent legal-policy think tank; self-published its submission to RBI's 2019 payment-gateways/aggregators discussion paper — including the delegated-legislation argument on the PSS Act. One of the few commenters whose RBI consultation position is public by its own choice.

name: Dvara Research
role: Research institution focused on financial-systems design for low-income households; publishes on customer-protection architecture in payments and credit.

name: CUTS International
role: Consumer-interest NGO (Consumer Unity & Trust Society) that files comments in financial-sector consultations from the user's side of the table.

name: Finance Industry Development Council
role: RBI-recognised SRO for NBFCs; per SROTrac's tracking the most active consultation respondent among the recognised SROs. Roster and governance tracked at SROTrac.

name: Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment
role: RBI-recognised fintech SRO (Aug 2024); responds to digital-lending consultations. Roster and governance tracked at SROTrac.

name: Unified Fintech Forum
role: RBI-recognised fintech SRO (Sep 2026; born as DLAI); its member roster is the who's-who of fintech policy interest. Tracked at SROTrac.

name: Sahamati
role: RBI-recognised SRO for the account-aggregator ecosystem; chaired since 2025 by former RBI Deputy Governor R. Gandhi — a documented revolving-door row (see Doors).

name: Microfinance Institutions Network
role: RBI-recognised SRO for NBFC-MFIs (2014); H.R. Khan (former RBI DG) was appointed first chairman of the Code for Responsible Lending steering committee in micro-credit — see Doors.

name: Sa-Dhan
role: RBI-recognised SRO (2015) for community-development finance institutions. Tracked at SROTrac.

name: Foreign Exchange Dealers' Association of India
role: RBI-recognised SRO (Jan 2026) of authorised forex dealers; writes its own market rulebook. Tracked at SROTrac.

name: Self-Regulated PSO Association
role: RBI-recognised SRO (Nov 2025) of payment system operators founded by practitioners. Tracked at SROTrac.
